title: Discovering novel Cathepsin L inhibitors from natural products using artificial intelligence
summary: Discovering novel Cathepsin L inhibitors from natural products using artificial intelligence. Screened natural products for Cathepsin L inhibitors; 150 molecules were selected for testing. 36 of 150 inhibited CTSL by more than 50 percent at 100 uM; 13 exceeded 90 percent; plumbagin and beta-lapachone were most potent. Evidence limits: Only enzyme assays and MD; cellular or in vivo effects and hit-rate against a random baseline not assessed. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
ai_technology: Deep learning model with molecular docking
organization: Beijing Key Laboratory of Diabetes Research and Care, Beijing Diabetes Institute, Beijing Tongren Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing 100730, China.
